text: Figure 7.11: Mapping between the priority of an received Ethernet frame and the egress port queues May be a Ethernet switch hardware cannot provide 8 queues per egress port. In such a case only a subset of traffic classes should be used. Starting from traffic class 0 in consecutive and ascending order. T able 7.4 shows an example of traffic class to egress port queue mapping, if only 4 queues are provided by an Ethernet switch hardware.
